findings.what: The Go back click handler goes back only if `ours && history.length > 1`. The spec's decision says to go back whenever document.referrer is same-origin. It names `history.length > 1` as a rejected condition, and here it is added as an extra guard. A same-origin referrer with history.length 1 would go to / instead of back.
findings.fix: Drop `&& history.length > 1` so the condition is just the same-origin referrer check.

findings.what: The States table says Go back is hidden on the 200 rows and the Filter links are hidden on the 404 row. Only the 404 page's Go back and missing nav are checked. No test asserts that 200 pages (including the empty-table and empty-category states) have no Go back link. The 'No items yet.' state is not checked for its filter links with All current. The script test is a loose regex that would also match the wrong condition.
findings.fix: Assert that the 200 pages contain no 'Go back' / id="back", and that the empty-table page shows the nav with All current.

findings.what: A generated no-op reset migration is part of the diff without any mention in the spec.
findings.fix: Confirm that it belongs to this change, or drop it.
